entries.head: pass around

senses.en: when an illness spreads among people

example.en: A stomach bug is passing around the office.
example.zh: 办公室在传肠胃炎。

entries.l1_note: 传染开是 pass around；不是 pass to（传给一个）。

entries.head: come out in

senses.en: to get spots or a rash

example.en: He came out in red spots after the injection.
example.zh: 打完针他起了一身红点。

entries.l1_note: 起疹子是 come out in；break out in 同义。

entries.head: double up

senses.en: to bend over because of pain

example.en: She doubled up with cramps on the subway.
example.zh: 她在地铁上疼得弯下腰。

entries.l1_note: 疼得弯腰是 double up (with pain)；double up 也指两人合住。

entries.head: throw out

senses.en: to injure your back by moving suddenly

example.en: I threw out my back lifting the suitcase.
example.zh: 拎箱子的时候把腰闪了。

entries.l1_note: 闪到腰是 throw out your back；不是“扔出去”。

entries.head: bandage up

senses.en: to wrap a wound with a bandage

example.en: The nurse bandaged up my wrist in two minutes.
example.zh: 护士两分钟把我手腕包好了。

entries.l1_note: 包扎是 bandage up；bandage 单独是绷带。

entries.head: stitch up

senses.en: to close a wound with stitches

example.en: They stitched up the cut in the ER.
example.zh: 急诊室把伤口缝上了。

entries.l1_note: 缝针是 stitch up；stitch up 也有“陷害”的俚语义。

entries.head: rub on

senses.en: to apply a cream by rubbing

example.en: Rub on the ointment twice a day.
example.zh: 药膏一天抹两次。

entries.l1_note: 抹上药是 rub on；抹进皮肤是 rub in。

entries.head: go down

senses.en: when swelling or fever decreases

example.en: The swelling went down after two days of ice.
example.zh: 冰敷两天后肿消了。

entries.l1_note: 消下去是 go down；退烧是 bring down a fever。

entries.head: bring down

senses.en: to reduce a fever

example.en: Take this to bring the fever down.
example.zh: 吃这个把烧退下来。

entries.l1_note: 退烧是 bring down a fever；不是 stop the fever。

entries.head: lie down

senses.en: to put your body flat

example.en: You should lie down for twenty minutes.
example.zh: 你躺二十分钟。

entries.l1_note: 躺下是 lie down；lay down 是“把东西放下”。

entries.head: sit up

senses.en: to move from lying to sitting

example.en: Sit up slowly — you might feel dizzy.
example.zh: 慢慢坐起来，可能会头晕。

entries.l1_note: 坐起来是 sit up；sit in 是旁听。

entries.head: get up

senses.en: to rise from bed or a chair

example.en: He got up too fast and blacked out.
example.zh: 他起得太猛，眼前一黑。

entries.l1_note: 起身是 get up；wake up 是醒来。

entries.head: turn over

senses.en: to change position in bed

example.en: The nurse turned him over every two hours.
example.zh: 护士每两小时给他翻一次身。

entries.l1_note: 翻身是 turn over；turn around 是掉头。

entries.head: bring round

senses.en: to make someone conscious again

example.en: They brought her round with smelling salts.
example.zh: 他们用嗅盐把她弄醒了。

entries.l1_note: 使苏醒是 bring round（英式）；美式说 bring around。

entries.head: fight back

senses.en: when your body resists an illness

example.en: His immune system fought back faster than expected.
example.zh: 他的免疫系统恢复得比预期快。

entries.l1_note: 抵抗是 fight back；fight off 是挡住。

entries.head: fend off

senses.en: to keep something away

example.en: Good sleep helps fend off colds.
example.zh: 睡得好能少感冒。

entries.l1_note: 挡开是 fend off；fend for yourself 是自己谋生。

entries.head: stave off

senses.en: to delay something bad

example.en: Exercise can stave off back pain.
example.zh: 锻炼能延缓腰痛。

entries.l1_note: 延缓是 stave off；stave 单独是木板。

entries.head: rest up

senses.en: to rest until you feel better

example.en: Rest up for a couple of days and drink water.
example.zh: 休息两天，多喝水。

entries.l1_note: 好好休息是 rest up；rest 单独是休息一下。

entries.head: live with

senses.en: to accept a condition you cannot cure

example.en: Many people live with chronic back pain.
example.zh: 很多人带着慢性腰痛生活。

entries.l1_note: 带着病生活是 live with；live on 是靠……过活。

entries.head: look after

senses.en: to take care of someone

example.en: She looked after her dad for a month.
example.zh: 她照顾了她爸一个月。

entries.l1_note: 照顾是 look after；look for 是找。

entries.head: care for

senses.en: to provide care for someone

example.en: The clinic cares for elderly patients at home.
example.zh: 诊所为老人提供上门照护。

entries.l1_note: 照料是 care for；care about 是关心。

entries.head: wait on

senses.en: to serve and attend to someone

example.en: He waited on his mom all week in the hospital.
example.zh: 他在医院伺候了他妈一周。

entries.l1_note: 伺候是 wait on；wait for 是等。

entries.head: take hold

senses.en: when an illness starts to affect you strongly

example.en: The infection took hold before the antibiotics worked.
example.zh: 抗生素起效前感染已经发作。

entries.l1_note: 发作扎根是 take hold；不是“抓住”。

entries.head: spread to

senses.en: to move into another part

example.en: The rash spread to his arms overnight.
example.zh: 疹子一夜之间蔓延到胳膊。

entries.l1_note: 扩散到是 spread to；spread 单独是铺开。

entries.head: keep off

senses.en: to avoid something

example.en: Keep off alcohol while you're on these pills.
example.zh: 吃这些药期间别喝酒。

entries.l1_note: 忌口是 keep off；stay off 同义。

entries.head: watch for

senses.en: to look out for signs of something

example.en: Watch for swelling around the bite.
example.zh: 注意咬伤周围有没有肿。

entries.l1_note: 留意症状是 watch for；watch out 是小心危险。

entries.head: test out

senses.en: to examine something to find the cause

example.en: The doctor wants to test out a few possibilities.
example.zh: 医生想把几种可能都查一下。

entries.l1_note: 检查确认是 test out；test 单独是测试。

entries.head: screen for

senses.en: to test people for a condition

example.en: They screen for diabetes at the annual checkup.
example.zh: 年度体检会筛查糖尿病。

entries.l1_note: 筛查是 screen for；screen 单独是屏幕、遮挡。

entries.head: rule out

senses.en: to decide an illness is not the cause

example.en: The blood test ruled out an infection.
example.zh: 血检排除了感染。

entries.l1_note: 排除是 rule out；不是“定规矩”。

entries.head: look over

senses.en: to examine something fairly quickly

example.en: The doctor looked over the X-rays and nodded.
example.zh: 医生看了看片子，点了点头。

entries.l1_note: 检查一遍是 look over；look into 是调查。
